events.description: A dark sedan loses control on a rural highway, veers off the road onto the grassy shoulder, rolls multiple times down an embankment, and comes to rest heavily damaged in a cloud of dust.

A dark-colored car loses control on a wet road, skids sideways, and collides with the roadside curb or barrier, producing a visible spray of water/road debris. The incident occurs ahead of the camera vehicle, near a yield sign and blue trash bin.

The bus (camera vehicle) is struck from the side or front, causing violent interior disruption: the driver is thrown against the steering wheel, the windshield shatters inward, and passengers are jolted violently. The speedometer reads 0 km/h at impact, indicating the bus was stopped or nearly stopped when hit.

The bus collides violently with an object or vehicle, causing the windshield to shatter, the driver's cabin to deform, and the driver to be thrown forward; the speed drops from 1 km/h to 0 km/h at impact.
Passengers are thrown about inside the bus due to the crash impact; seats are dislodged, people are airborne and piled together, indicating severe interior disruption following the initial collision.
A bus is struck violently, causing catastrophic interior deformation and passengers to be thrown about; the crash occurs between frames f4 and f11.
External dashcam view shows a white sedan colliding with a large truck at an intersection; the impact occurs around frame f15.

A head-on collision occurs between a silver sedan (approaching from left) and a light-colored station wagon (approaching from right) at an intersection; both vehicles sustain severe front-end damage, with debris and dust erupting upon impact.

Post-collision aftermath: both vehicles are heavily damaged and stationary in the intersection; occupants visible in the station wagon (driver and passenger), with the driver appearing dazed or injured; no fire or explosion observed, but significant structural deformation and scattered debris persist.

Two vehicles collide at an intersection: a dark SUV (left) and a light-colored sedan (right). The SUV's front is severely crumpled; the sedan is pushed sideways with visible damage to its front and driver-side door. Debris is scattered on the road surface.

A light-colored sedan (same as in first event) is seen driving slowly through a congested urban street, approaching the camera vehicle. It appears to be maneuvering after the earlier crash, possibly attempting to exit the scene or reposition. No new collision occurs in this segment, but the vehicle’s damaged state and context indicate it is part of the same accident sequence.
Two women in the back seat engage in mutual physical combat: one lunges forward and grabs the other, who then retaliates by pulling hair and grappling; both are actively involved in the struggle.

After the initial mutual fight, one woman (in purple top) appears subdued and is held down or restrained by the other (in blue top), who continues to exert control—suggesting a shift from mutual combat to one-sided aggression against a now-helpless victim.

Two women in the back seat engage in mutual physical combat: one with blonde hair grabs the other woman's arm and upper body while the other resists, both showing active struggle and facial expressions of exertion and distress.

A high-speed collision occurs on a multi-lane highway: a dark sedan impacts a white vehicle (likely a van or SUV) from the right, causing the white vehicle to violently roll over multiple times across the lanes while debris scatters. A person is ejected and lands on the road surface during the rollover.

A separate traffic incident on a different road segment: a silver hatchback swerves sharply left, crossing the lane line and appearing to collide with or narrowly miss a blue car ahead in the adjacent lane; the scene is partially obscured by visual artifacts but shows clear evasive maneuvering and proximity consistent with a near-miss or minor impact.

A vehicle (likely a truck or SUV) is struck from the side or rear, causing it to be violently launched into the air and rotate mid-flight before descending out of view. Debris and dust are visible at impact.
